# FinSim

> FinSim is a gamified financial literacy platform for students. It teaches financial
> knowledge, behavior, attitude and skills through an interactive financial simulation
> game with engaging gameplay and student progress tracking.

FinSim is aimed at schools, colleges and educators who want to deliver financial
education without dry lectures. Students move through interactive financial modules
inside a simulation, and instructors can track student progress.

## Key details

- Product: FinSim, a financial simulation game for financial literacy education
- Audience: students, schools, colleges, educators
- Delivery: web-based, no installation required
- Core areas: financial knowledge, financial behavior, financial attitude, financial skills
